title: Wood Child & Hidden Forest Mother
description: Join us on a hunt like no other. Deep in the forest, a naked hunter shoots the wrong prey, but rectifying his mistake doesn’t go the way he, or we, expect. Oddly touching, this outlandish film leads us around on a merry dance, threatening to animate itself off the screen
sound: Keith Duncan A family of huge lizards arrive on the sea-shore for their centenary picnic and discover to their horror that humans have built a city on their favourite spot. A rival creature also has designs on their territory and so havoc and chaos ensue
